title: The Triple Girlfriend Lunch Dilemma — Part 1

series.summary: Rentaro introduces his three girlfriends on the school roof, but Hakari and Karane turn lunchtime into a furious feeding contest that leaves timid Shizuka feeling isolated and neglected. Desperate to prevent his harem from fracturing, Rentaro concocts a high-stakes group game to break the tension, but will the embarrassing penalty drive them further apart?

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro proudly introduces Hakari and Karane to Shizuka on the roof, but adding a third girlfriend creates instant romantic chaos.
Timid Shizuka bows nervously with her book, while Hakari and Karane size up their tiny new rival.
Lunchtime erupts into a vicious feeding war as Hakari and Karane fiercely compete to stuff their homemade food into Rentaro's mouth.
Watching from the sidelines, Shizuka clutches her tiny lunchbox in despair, convinced she cannot compete.
Determined to rescue her, Rentaro announces a chaotic card tournament with a humiliating tickle penalty. But will his daring gamble unite them, or tear them apart?
